engagements.cancel_freelancer_late_toast: Late cancellation — those days stay blocked on your calendar.
engagements.cancel_grace_confirm: Cancel this confirmed match? You are within the 24h grace window: no penalty and the Pit Call reopens for other candidates.
engagements.cancel_grace_toast: Cancelled within grace window — no penalty. The Pit Call is reopened.
engagements.cancel_late_freelancer_confirm: You are past the grace window. The engaged days remain blocked on your calendar and the Pit Call will be reopened for other candidates. Continue?
engagements.cancel_late_team_confirm: You are past the grace window. This cancellation will be recorded on your public team profile and the Pit Call will be archived. Continue?
engagements.cancel_team_late_toast: Late cancellation recorded on your team profile.
engagements.confirm_contacted_body: Confirm here as soon as you reach out to the freelancer. If you don't, automatic reminders will be sent and — after the deadline — the match will be released and logged on your team profile.
engagements.contact_check_followup: It's been a few days since the match — did the team already contact you?
engagements.contact_check_initial: As soon as the team gets in touch, click below. If they don't, we'll automatically remind them and — if they keep ghosting — release the match so your calendar reopens.
engagements.contact_logged_thanks: Thanks — logged that the team reached out.
engagements.team_no_followup_body: The team never confirmed contact after the match. The engagement was auto-released and your calendar days reopened. You can still leave a rating for the team below.
engagements.urgent_contact_body: You still haven't confirmed contact with the freelancer. If you don't confirm soon, the engagement will be auto-released, the freelancer's calendar will reopen, and the incident will be recorded on your team profile.
engagements.waitlist_toast: Another freelancer accepted first — you're on the waitlist. Your calendar stays open in case the match reopens.

matches.confirm_match_prompt: Confirm this match? Your contact details will be shared with the team and the Pit Call will be closed.

new_request.anchor_team: Anchor: your team's fixed location from your profile.
new_request.calendar_legend: Selected (red) days = days you need the professional on-site.
new_request.date_end_before_start: End date cannot be earlier than the start date.
new_request.date_out_of_range: Date out of range. Use a date between 2025 and 2031.
new_request.distance_ignored: Distance is ignored — location has no effect on the match score.
new_request.distance_mandatory_note: Hard filter — freelancers outside the radius are excluded from matches.
new_request.distance_relevant_note: Freelancers inside the radius get the full location score, near-radius (≤ 1.2×) get half, further out zero.
new_request.education_soft_note: Soft preference only — freelancers with other education levels can still match. Click to toggle.
new_request.experience_add_up_to: Add up to {{max}} categories with minimum years. Mark each as
new_request.experience_hard_note: (freelancers who don't meet it are excluded from matches) or leave as
new_request.identical_locked_note: All fields below are locked to guarantee the discounted price ({{repostCost}} tokens instead of {{baseCost}}). Need to change something? Use
new_request.languages_add_up_to: Add up to {{max}} required languages and their minimum level. Mark as
new_request.languages_hard_note: to exclude freelancers who don't meet it, or leave
new_request.location_cycle_tooltip: Click to cycle: Not relevant → Relevant → Mandatory
new_request.macro_role_hard_filter: Hard filter — only {{role}} professionals will match.
new_request.pick_location_hint: Pick a location from the dropdown so we can capture its coordinates.
new_request.preview_helper: Review the request before posting. The preview updates as you edit the form.
new_request.modify_helper: Update the request during its review window. Matching changes are checked server-side.
new_request.season_working_days_help: Click every day you need the specialist on the ground across the season. Matches are computed against these exact days.
new_request.select_working_day: Select at least one working day for the season
new_request.skill_cycle_help_suffix: (freelancer must have it), a third time to deselect.
new_request.travel_hard_suffix: requirement — only freelancers who marked themselves as available to travel will be matched.

request_matches.confirm_match_prompt: Send a confirmation request for this match? If the freelancer accepts, the Pit Call is closed, all other pending proposals for it are cancelled, and contacts are exchanged.
request_matches.confirmation_sent: Match confirmation sent to the freelancer
request_matches.keep_searching_body: Leave the request live. As soon as a freelancer becomes 100% available, you're notified and the standard first-come-first-served flow resumes. No refund — the search is still alive.
request_matches.matches_intro_1: Matches are grouped in three tiers.
request_matches.matches_intro_2: are always previewable for free (technical details, no contacts). Ranks 4–10 stay blurred until you spend {{cost}} token(s) per profile. Tiers 2 (11–20) and 3 (21–50) require a one-time entry fee — reduced proportionally when fewer matches exist. Nothing beyond rank {{hardCap}} is ever exposed.
request_matches.no_matches_yet: No matches for this request yet.
request_matches.partial_banner_case_a_2: , but there are partial matches with a
request_matches.partial_banner_case_a_3: affinity (with some missing days). Want to see them?
request_matches.partial_banner_case_b: Looking for more options with flexible dates? Check other professionals with partial availability and evaluate their missing days.
request_matches.partial_refund_credited: {{tokens}} token(s) credited ({{pct}}%). Partial matches are now open below.
request_matches.pitcall_preview_body: Coverage is calculated from the current request and selected dates. You can still adjust the Pit Call during this review window before it becomes visible to freelancers.
request_matches.potential_red: NO CURRENT COVERAGE ON THE SELECTED DATES
request_matches.activate_now_confirm: End the review window now and make this Pit Call visible to freelancers?
request_matches.activate_failed: Could not publish the Pit Call
request_matches.red_cancel_confirm: Cancel this RED Pit Call and get 100% of the tokens back? This cannot be undone.
request_matches.red_cancel_failed: Cancellation not available for this Pit Call
request_matches.proportional_note: Only {{count}} real match(es) in this tier (max {{max}}). Entry fee reduced proportionally from {{full}} to {{cost}} token(s).
request_matches.refund_close_body: Accept the {{full}}-token refund and archive this request as completed — unfilled. Final: no further changes.
request_matches.refund_close_confirm: Close this request and take a refund of {{full}} token(s) ({{pct}}% of {{spent}})? The request will be archived as unfilled.
request_matches.refund_partial_confirm: Unlock partial matches now and take a HALVED refund of {{partial}} token(s)? You keep browsing partial candidates; if a full match later confirms, no additional refund is granted.
request_matches.refund_quote_basis: The exact amount reflects how specific this Pit Call was and the outcome it reached.
request_matches.search_stays_active: Search stays active. You'll be notified as soon as a full match appears.
request_matches.sos_confirm: Trigger SOS Call for today? Every high-affinity freelancer available today will be notified. The first to accept locks the match — this is irreversible.
request_matches.sos_description: Emergency broadcast to all high-affinity freelancers available today. The first to accept fills the match automatically.
request_matches.sos_sent: SOS Call sent to {{count}} freelancer(s) at ≥{{pct}}% affinity.
request_matches.tech_details_hidden_note: Technical details are hidden until you unlock ({{cost}} token(s)). Real name and contacts appear only after the freelancer confirms the match.
request_matches.unlock_partials_body_has: See freelancers available only for part of the dates now. Refund is halved to {{partial}} token(s). Request stays open — if a full match later confirms, no extra refund.
request_matches.unlock_partials_body_none: No partial candidates exist for this Pit Call yet.
request_matches.unlock_tier_confirm: Unlock {{label}} tier {{tier}} for {{cost}} token(s)? This exposes {{count}} more match card(s) (still blurred until per-profile unlock).
request_matches.unlock_tier_confirm_reduced: Unlock {{label}} tier {{tier}} for {{cost}} token(s)? (Reduced from {{full}} — only {{count}} real matches available in this tier.)
